name: Faust Norbert
original_name: ファウスト=ノルベルト
source:
The Second Seat of the "Seventh Chord". He acts as a right-hand man, and gathered up the members of the group in place of the Knights's leader. A buoyant old man who is a very influential person in the "Seventh Chord" that has witnessed many scenes of bloodshed. His general hobby is outdoor fishing. Faust tends to admire nature. On the other hand, he also has a broad knowledge on the latest technological developments in the city. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=853983]Getchu[/url]]
